content: Ngawe-ngigac gocnedi hegilecnagucaigaing
Yesu ye yowa yogo miyackeme motome Galili prowins hegilelu Yudeya himongka Yodan misa nebocina hikewec.
Hikeme ngic-ngigac habu sugucnebenangti ye balaibebong yedi ngic-ngigac hucnginengkolec iwa bamadicebawec.
Aime Farisaio yenge yela kwesilu kwesackeningte yanguc uwacnoibong, “Ngic monic ye ngigacine wiyac kpisicnele hegilenale, yogolec yefe fagac, me?”
Inguc mibong Yesudi bafaliyelu yanguc edocebawec,

content.text: “Mime Fike-fike fileinedi molickelu mime
‘Ngic nga ngigac fikeiboc, inguc bafuwacepawec.’
Ngenge yogo wafe-ngagec aicaigaing.
Ye bafuwacepalu yanguc miwec,
‘Ilec ailu ngic ye nenggac-mamackecine hegilecepalu ngigacineholec wetackelu yeholec soc moniyang aidabiyecte.’
(Fike 2:24)
Inguc aidabiyectewa, yeke hatacmac yaeckang mi aigaic, yeke soc moniyang aigaic. Ilec ailu Wapongti wetacepawec, yogo ngicti mi welockedaic.”

content: Inguc mime yanguc miibong, “Aime wenucte Mosesdi ung-yowa yanguc nolewec? Ngic monicti ngigac hegilenogale hibi kwelengkelu ngigac lacnome ngigac ye ngic yogo hegilelu hikedaic.”
Inguc mibong Yesudi yanguc miwec,

content.text: “Ngenge ngic kwelengineng fongkeicne. Ilec ailu Mosesdi ngigacfocngineng hegilecebaningte aka mi lowec. Aime molickelu ofeicne iwa yefe ingucne monic mi fawec.
Na yanguc edocngebabe, ngic monicti ngigacine selo-boic aibaba mi aiyemewa ye moc hegilelu ngigac monic badaicte, ngic yogo ye selo-boic aibaba aidaicte.”

content: Inguc mime ngagelu mic-tengtengfocine yengi yanguc miibong, “Ilec ailu ngawe-ngigac mi ailu adu-madechac domalu momoc mi ganoga, yogodibac madickedaicte.”
Inguc mibong Yesudi yanguc edocebawec,

content.text: “Ngengele yowa ngic gocne mi balaibedaingte. Wapongti ngic inguc baficebame yengi sugu ngawe-ngigac mi aidaingte.

Ngic gocne yenge nenggac kwelewacni hufing fikeibong. Nga gocne yenge ngicti aibaba aiyelebong hufing aiibong. Nga ngic gocne yenge honocmengte ngani-damongte ailu hufing ingucne gacaigaing. Ngic monic ye yowa yogo ngagelu banogale nalic ye yowa yogo badaic.”

content: Adu-madec mimi-madic milu edocebawec

Aime ngic-ngigac yenge adu-madecfocngineng kpisicne Yesula bacebalu hikebong, yedi moledi adu-madec feinginang lolu milockenale ngageibong. Inguc aibong mic-tengtengfocine yengi ngelengkelu edocebaibong.
Aime Yesudi yanguc miwec,

content.text: “Adu-madec kpisicne yenge nala nalic kwesining. Ngenge aka mi holeyelening. Honocmengte ngani-damong yogo adu-madec kpisicne yangucne yengele.”

content: Inguc milu moleine feinginang lolu mimi-madic milu edocebame motome ye mac-himong yogo hegilelu monicka hikewec.
Ngic moneng-mafatowaineholec
Aime ngic monicti Yesula kwesilu miwec, “Wewedu, na aibaba madicne wenuc ailu gaga-sanang badacte?”
Inguc mime yedi yanguc miwec,

content.text: “Ga omale aibaba madicnele uwanelegic? Wapong moniyangti sugu madicne gagac. Aime ga gaga-sanangka fenogale milu Wapongte ung-yowa balaibedamec.”

content: Inguc mime yanguc miwec, “Ung-yowa weni yogo balaibenogale migic?” Inguc mime Yesudi yanguc miwec,

content.text: “ ‘Ga ngic-ngigac mi wehomacebadamec. Ailu selo-boic aibaba mi aidamec. Nga hise mi badamec. Ailu micka lolo mi aidamec.
Ga nenggac-mamackecgone alang bayetedamec.’
‘Ailu gageicne aigelecaigac, silicine ingucnehac ngic-ngigac gale emewa gagaing, yengele kwelegonedi ago aiyelelu angac ngageyelelu gadamec.’ ”

content: Inguc mime soc-gboli madec yedi miwec, “Na yogo sasawa balaibecaigabac. Aime oma wiyacka kpungkegabac?”
Mime Yesudi yanguc edowec,

content.text: “Ga ngic dondonnebenang ganogale ngagegicka ingucne, yanguc ainong, ga hikelu wiyacgone sasawa saleyackelu moneng balu ngic-ngigac waweweine gagaing, yogo yeledamec. Inguc aiyengka wiyac madicne honocmengka fikegeledaicte. Aime welelu na balaibecnudamec.”

content: Inguc mime soc-gboli madec yogo ye moneng nga woc-wiyacine bocyac facnowecte, yowa yogo ngagelu kweleine umaleme hikewec.
Honocmengte ngani-damong nga himongte moneng-mafa
Hikeme Yesudi mic-tengtengfocine yanguc edocebawec,

content.text: “Foinac, monic moneng nga woc-wiyacineholec ye honocmengte ngani-damong kwelina fenogale aidaicte, yogo boleine sugucnehac, yogo noine edocngebagabac.
Ailu hatacmac edocngebabe, kameldi bungic yefina fedaicte, yogo boleine sugucne. Nga moneng nga woc-wiyackolec yedi Wapongte ngani-damongka fenogale aidaicte, yogodibac boletowaine sugucnehac.”

content: Inguc mime mic-tengteng yenge yowa yogo ngagelu kwatackelu medecebame yanguc miibong, “Inguc aime madi nalic wasecne aidaicte?”
Inguc mibong Yesudi dongeine yengela hilalu yanguc miwec,

content.text: “Ngic-ngigac yengileng aibabanginengte ailu yogowa aibibiyelu hegiledaingte. Nga Wapongtibac wiyac sasawa yogo nalic aidaicte.”

content: Inguc mime Pitadi yanguc miwec, “Ngagegic, nonge woc-wiyacnonggeng sasawa hegilelu ga balaibecgulu gagabeleng. Ilec nonge oma wiyac badabelengte?”
Inguc mime Yesudi yanguc edocebawec,

content.text: “Foinac, gacgu wiyac sasawa gbolicne fikedaicte, dameng iwa Ngicte Madec ye honocmengte tapili nga hibi-angocineholecti ngictaule ngiye-ngiyewa ngiyedaicte. Aime ngic balaibecnucaigaing, ngenge inguchac ngictaule ngiye-ngiye 12 iwa ngiyelu Israel yengele ngambofocngineng 12 fagaing, yengele aibabangineng wosaelu mimoctodaingte, yogo noine edocngebagabac.

Aime ngic-ngigac nale wacte ailu macfocngineng me ngic hae-gbafocngineng me sengfocngineng me nenggac-mamacfocngineng me adu-madecfocngineng me himongngineng hegileibong. Wiyac yogolec ameine ngenge sasawadi 100 hatacmac badaingte. Ailu Sugucnedi gaga-sanang yeledaicte.
Ngic molic-molic gacaigaing, yengelacni homacnedi lobeine aidaingte. Nga lobeine gacaigaing, yengelacni homacnedi molic-molic aidaingte.”

footnotes.text: Yuda ngic-ngigac gocne yenge ngagebong ngigac ye selo-boic aibaba aiwec, yogo sugu ye nalic ngigac hegiledaicte. Nga Yuda ngic-ngigac gocne yenge ngagebong ngigac ye wiyac kpisicnele aiwec, yogo nalic ngigac hegiledaicte. Ilec ailu Farisaio yenge uuwa yogo lokwesacka loibong.
